title: Ya Ali Ya Ali Haider Haider
body:
Bande haidaram manu aazala misaram
Haame ifteqaar e meene man kalbe haidaram
Aye maah e Shab haaye man
Zikrat rabbaano ye man
Soz o qudaazami raaz o niyaazami asl e namaazami ya Ali
Thaneen e saazami qibla e raazami tuchaar e saazami ya Ali
Ya ali ya ali haider haider..(4)
Aaa...
noor e chashme paighambar
jaan e khatoone mehshar
fakhre shabbir o shabbar
aye mere maula haider
khaali jholi phaylaye
jo tere darr par hai aaye
na jaaye khali kabhi sawali aye mere waali
jaha'n tera darr hua mayassar bana muqaddar
Tu hai wo auj e fazilat
hai qael jiski mashiyat
jo tere bughz ki surat
ki thi haris ne jasarat
jab tere bughz mein bola
na jaacha aur na tola
harab pe waari ne aisi taari ki sang baari
kahe hawadis hai kon waris pada hai haris
Tha shaita'n ka karinda
tha  jo bazahir zinda
jab banke jaali murda
nikla dozakh ka kunda
uff ye haider ki haibat
padh di namaz e mayyat
ajal ka phanda lagake zinda pada tha murda
qaza pukari padi hai mehengi ali se masti... Ya Ali
Rab ki awaaz ye aayi
mehka do saari khudayi
maine naubat ye bajayi
Zahra ki hogi sagayi
bil akhir daala langar
teri dehleez pe aakar
tha maara maara jo ek sitara wohi pukara
nabi ki dukhtar tera muqaddar hai tera shauhar
Kya likhu jung e khaibar
mushkil mein the paighambar
jab aaya marhab e khudsar
nikle is simt se haider
zarb e haider jo khaayi
do tukdo mein laash aayi
chadhe jo tewar tha daste haider pe baabe khaibar
jo dekha manzar yahudi lashkar ko aayi chakkar
Beshak maulood e haram hai
tera sidra pe qadam hai
tujhko zahra ki qasam hai
jo bhi mohtaj e karam hai
aye rehmat e jaaweda'n
de raahat e qalbo jaa'n
teri rasai mein kul khudai nabi ke bhai
hamari qismat khuda ki jannat teri badaulat
Jis par uftad padi hai
jis par aafat ki ghadi hai
beja'n jo bhi qaidi hai
uski faryaad yahi hai
aye mard e khaibar shikan
aye nazish e panjetan
tere fidayi ko jag hasai se de rehayi
wo jaye ghar ab mita de ghum sab baraye zainab
Ab hai gardish mein sitara
dushman sansaar hai saara
maange rehmat ka ishara
tera har chahne wala
aye mere mushkil kusha
aye mere hajat rawa
ghamo ke maare ye shia saare tere sahare
ke fatha saara kare zamana laga ke naara
Aye hamida aap bhi kyu kar
hoga bayaan ye manzar
thi jis dum daste nabi par
aye shadma'n zaate haider
man kunto maula ali
jis waqt bole nabi
jina se badhkar suroor parwar tha qum ka manzar
nabi ka jumla hisaab saara chuka chuka tha
